[...] § 5º Quando a incorporação estiver submetida ao regime do patrimônio de afetação, de que tratam os arts. 31-A a 31-F desta Lei, o incorporador restituirá os valores pagos pelo adquirente, deduzidos os valores descritos neste artigo e atualizados com base no índice contratualmente estabelecido para a correção monetária das parcelas do preço do imóvel, no prazo máximo de 30 (trinta) dias após o habite-se ou documento equivalente expedido pelo órgão público municipal competente, [...] que a pena referida no inciso II do caput deste artigo seja estabelecida até o limite de 50% (cinquenta por cento) da quantia paga.
rules.translation: If a contract made only with the developer is undone, by mutual cancellation or by termination for the buyer's absolute failure to perform, the buyer is entitled to the return of the amounts paid directly to the developer, updated by the index set in the contract for adjusting the price instalments, minus, cumulatively: I. the whole brokerage commission; II. the contractual penalty, which may not exceed 25% (twenty-five per cent) of the amount paid. [...] Paragraph 5. When the development is under the segregated estate regime of articles 31-A to 31-F of this Law, the developer will return the amounts paid by the buyer, minus the amounts described in this article and updated by the index set in the contract for adjusting the price instalments, within no more than 30 (thirty) days after the occupancy permit (habite-se) or equivalent document issued by the competent municipal body, [...] the penalty in item II of the caput of this article being allowed up to 50% (fifty per cent) of the amount paid.

rules.title: In Saudi Arabia, a developer needs a licence for each off-plan project, and an escrow account agreement with a licensed bank
rules.plain: A developer that wants to sell or lease units off-plan must first be entered in the register of developers and then apply for a licence for that specific project. The application must include, among other documents, a valid building permit, the title deed, a model sale contract with delivery dates fixed to the day, and an agreement with a bank licensed in the Kingdom to open an escrow account. Ask for the project licence before you pay.
rules.quote: يجب على المطور الراغب في بيع أو تأجير مشروعات عقارية على الخارطة -بعد قيد اسمه في سجل قيد المطورين- أن يقدم طلبًا إلى الجهة المختصة للحصول على الترخيص الخاص للمشروع العقاري مشفوعًا بما يلي: [...] د- رخصة بناء للمشروع العقاري سارية المفعول. هـ- صك تسجيل الملكية (ساري المفعول) للعقار المراد تطويره. [...] م- نموذج عقد بيع بينه وبين المشتري ومواعيد تسليم المبيع محددة باليوم بما يتفق مع أحكام النظام واللائحة وغير متعارضة مع أحكام الشريعة الإسلامية. ن- اتفاقية فتح حساب ضمان بينه وبين بنك مرخص له في المملكة، بما يتفق مع أحكام النظام واللائحة.
rules.translation: A developer wishing to sell or lease real estate projects off-plan must, after its name has been entered in the register of developers, apply to the competent authority for the licence of the real estate project, together with the following: [...] (d) a valid building permit for the real estate project. (e) a valid title deed for the property to be developed. [...] (m) a model sale contract between the developer and the buyer, with delivery dates for the unit fixed to the day, consistent with the Law and the Regulations and not contrary to the provisions of Islamic Sharia. (n) an agreement to open an escrow account between the developer and a bank licensed in the Kingdom, consistent with the Law and the Regulations.

rules.title: Each project has its own escrow account, used only for that project and protected from the developer's creditors
rules.plain: An independent escrow account is opened in the name of each project and is activated only after the project licence is issued and the title deed is annotated. The account may be used only to pay for that licensed project, and the developer's creditors cannot seize the money in it. Pay only into the escrow account of the project named in your contract.
rules.quote: ينشأ حساب ضمان مستقل باسم كل مشروع عقاري، ولا يُفعَّل إلا بعد الحصول على الترخيص الخاص للمشروع العقاري والتأشير على صك تسجيل الملكية للعقار المراد تطويره. [...] يكون حساب الضمان مخصصًا لأغراض الصرف على المشروع العقاري المرخص له فقط، ولا يجوز الحجز على المبالغ المودعة فيه لمصلحة دائني المطور.
rules.translation: An independent escrow account is established in the name of each real estate project, and it is activated only after the licence for the real estate project has been obtained and the title deed of the property to be developed has been annotated. [...] The escrow account is dedicated to spending on the licensed real estate project only, and the amounts deposited in it may not be seized for the benefit of the developer's creditors.

rules.title: No more than 20% of the price of sold units may leave escrow for marketing, admin and other non-construction costs
rules.plain: The developer may draw on the escrow account for administrative, marketing and other non-construction costs only up to 20% of the value of each unit sold, and the project's chartered accountant must check that the total for these costs never exceeds 20% of the value of all units sold. The rest pays for building.
rules.quote: يجوز للمطور طلب الصرف من حساب الضمان للمصاريف الإدارية والتسويقية -والمصاريف الأخرى غير الإنشائية للمشروع العقاري المرخص له- بنسبة لا تتجاوز (20%) من قيمة الوحدة العقارية المبيعة. وعلى المحاسب القانوني التأكد من ألا يتجاوز مجموع ما يصرف من حساب الضمان للمصاريف غير الإنشائية ما نسبته (20%) من إجمالي قيمة الوحدات العقارية المبيعة.
rules.translation: The developer may request payment from the escrow account for administrative and marketing expenses, and other non-construction expenses of the licensed real estate project, at a rate not exceeding (20%) of the value of the unit sold. The chartered accountant must ensure that the total paid from the escrow account for non-construction expenses does not exceed (20%) of the total value of the units sold.

rules.title: If handover is late for a reason within the developer's control, the buyer is owed compensation
rules.plain: The developer must finish the project by the date set for completion. If the land or unit is handed over late for a reason that was not beyond the developer's control, the buyer is entitled to compensation: an amount fixed in advance for serviced land, or the fair rent of a similar home for a residential unit.
rules.quote: يلتزم المطور بإنهاء المشروع العقاري في الموعد المحدد لإنجازه. وفي حال التأخر عن تسليم الأرض أو الوحدة العقارية دون سبب خارج عن إرادته؛ فيستحق المشتري تعويضاً ماديًّا يحدد مسبقاً إن كانت أرضاً مطورة، أو أجرة مثلٍ إن كانت وحدة سكنية.
rules.translation: The developer is bound to finish the real estate project by the date set for its completion. If delivery of the land or the unit is delayed without a reason beyond the developer's control, the buyer is entitled to financial compensation fixed in advance if it is developed land, or the equivalent rent if it is a residential unit.

rules.title: In British Columbia, a developer must file a disclosure statement before marketing, and give it to you before you sign
rules.plain: A developer may not market units in a development until it has prepared a disclosure statement for the development and filed it with the Superintendent of Real Estate. It may not sign a purchase agreement with you until it has given you a copy, given you a reasonable chance to read it, and obtained your written acknowledgement that you had that chance.
rules.quote: A developer must not market a development unit unless the developer has (a) prepared a disclosure statement respecting the development property in which the development unit is located, and (b) filed with the superintendent (i) the disclosure statement described under paragraph (a), and (ii) any records required by the superintendent under subsection (3). [...] A developer must not enter into a purchase agreement with a purchaser for the sale or lease of a development unit unless (a) a copy of the disclosure statement prepared in respect of the development property in which the development unit is located has been provided to the purchaser, (b) the purchaser has been afforded reasonable opportunity to read the disclosure statement, and (c) the developer has obtained a written statement from the purchaser acknowledging that the purchaser had an opportunity to read the disclosure statement.

rules.title: Your deposit goes into a trust account held by a brokerage, lawyer or notary, not to the developer
rules.plain: A developer that receives your deposit must promptly place it with a real estate brokerage, a lawyer, a notary public or another prescribed person, who holds it as trustee in a trust account at a savings institution in British Columbia. The trustee holds it for both of you, not as the agent of either, and may release it only in the cases the Act lists. Make the deposit cheque or transfer out to the trustee named in your contract.
rules.quote: A developer who receives a deposit from a purchaser in relation to a development unit must promptly place the deposit with a brokerage, lawyer, notary public or prescribed person who must hold the deposit as trustee in a trust account in a savings institution in British Columbia. (2) A trustee under subsection (1) holds the deposit for the developer and the purchaser and not as an agent for either of them and must not release the deposit from trust except as follows: [...]

rules.title: You can cancel the purchase in writing within 7 days after signing or after acknowledging the disclosure statement
rules.plain: You may rescind the purchase agreement by serving written notice on the developer within 7 days after the later of the day the agreement was made and the day you signed the acknowledgement that you had a chance to read the disclosure statement. This applies even if title has already been transferred.
rules.quote: Regardless of whether title, or the other interest for which a purchaser has contracted, to a development unit has been transferred, a purchaser of the development unit may rescind the purchase agreement by serving written notice of the rescission on the developer within 7 days after the later of (a) the date that the purchase agreement was made, and (b) the date that the developer obtained, under section 15 (1) (c) [providing disclosure statements to purchasers] , a written statement from the purchaser acknowledging that the purchaser had an opportunity to read (i) the disclosure statement provided under that section, or (ii) a new disclosure statement, if any, described in section 16 (1) (a) (i) [non-compliant disclosure statements] .

rules.title: In Colombia, a developer must file the project papers with the city before selling homes, and buyers may read them at any time
rules.plain: Anyone who wants to sell homes in a housing plan must first file with the city or district office that supervises housing construction and sales: a recent property title extract (no older than three months), the model sale contracts, the project budget, the building licence (except under the pre-sale system) and, if the land is mortgaged, the lender's commitment to release each unit as it is sold. These papers are open to buyers at all times, so ask the city office to see them before you pay.
rules.quote: El interesado en adelantar planes de vivienda deberá radicar únicamente los siguientes documentos ante la instancia de la administración municipal o distrital encargada de ejercer la vigilancia y control de las actividades de construcción y enajenación de inmuebles contempladas en la Ley 66 de 1968 y el Decreto 2610 de 1979: a. Folio de matrícula inmobiliaria del inmueble o inmuebles objeto de la solicitud, cuya fecha de expedición no sea superior a tres (3) meses; b. Copia de los modelos de contratos que se vayan a utilizar en la celebración de los negocios de enajenación de inmuebles con los adquirientes, a fin de comprobar la coherencia y validez de las cláusulas con el cumplimiento de las normas que civil y comercialmente regulen el contrato; c. El presupuesto financiero del proyecto; d. Licencia urbanística respectiva, salvo que se trate del sistema de preventas; e. Cuando el inmueble en el cual ha de desarrollarse el plan o programa se encuentre gravado con hipoteca, ha de acreditarse que el acreedor hipotecario se obliga a liberar los lotes o construcciones que se vayan enajenando, mediante el pago proporcional del gravamen que afecte cada lote o construcción. PARÁGRAFO 1. Estos documentos estarán a disposición de los compradores de los planes de vivienda en todo momento con el objeto de que sobre ellos efectúen los estudios necesarios para determinar la conveniencia de la adquisición.
rules.translation: Anyone wishing to carry out housing plans must file only the following documents with the municipal or district office in charge of supervising and controlling the construction and sale of property covered by Law 66 of 1968 and Decree 2610 of 1979: a. The property registration extract of the property or properties concerned, issued no more than three (3) months earlier; b. A copy of the model contracts to be used for sales to buyers, so that the consistency and validity of their clauses with the civil and commercial rules governing the contract can be checked; c. The financial budget of the project; d. The relevant planning licence, except under the pre-sale system; e. Where the property on which the plan is to be built is mortgaged, proof that the mortgage lender undertakes to release the plots or buildings as they are sold, against proportional payment of the charge on each plot or building. Paragraph 1. These documents will be available to buyers of the housing plans at all times, so that they can study them to decide whether the purchase suits them.

rules.title: For 10 years after occupancy, the builder or seller of a new home must cover owners' losses from serious structural failure
rules.plain: If, within ten years after the technical occupancy certificate of a new home, one of the situations in article 2060(3) of the Civil Code occurs, the builder or the seller of the new home must cover the financial losses of the affected owners. They must back this duty with their own assets, bank guarantees, financial products or insurance. Ask which cover your project has.
rules.quote: Sin perjuicio de la garantía legal de la que trata el artículo 8 o de la Ley 1480 de 2011, en el evento que dentro de los diez (10) años siguientes a la expedición de la certificación Técnica de Ocupación de una vivienda nueva, se presente alguna de las situaciones contempladas en el numeral 3 del artículo 2060 del Código Civil, el constructor o el enajenador de vivienda nueva, estará obligado a cubrir los perjuicios patrimoniales causados a los propietarios que se vean afectados. PARÁGRAFO. El constructor o el enajenador de vivienda nueva deberán amparar los perjuicios patrimoniales a los que hace referencia la presente ley a través de su patrimonio, garantías bancarias, productos financieros o seguros, entre otros. El Gobierno nacional reglamentará la materia.
rules.translation: Without prejudice to the legal guarantee in article 8 of Law 1480 of 2011, if within the ten (10) years following the issue of the Technical Occupancy Certificate of a new home one of the situations set out in number 3 of article 2060 of the Civil Code occurs, the builder or the seller of the new home will be bound to cover the financial losses caused to the owners affected. Paragraph. The builder or the seller of new housing must cover the financial losses referred to in this law through their own assets, bank guarantees, financial products or insurance, among others. The national Government will regulate the matter.

rules.title: In Morocco, you can withdraw from a reservation contract within one month and get everything back within 7 days
rules.plain: Before the preliminary sale contract, you may sign a reservation contract. You can withdraw from it within one month of signing, and the seller must then return the whole amount paid within seven days. A reservation lasts at most six months, after which it must become a preliminary sale contract or be cancelled with a refund. Money paid at reservation goes into a special bank account and cannot be used or seized until your withdrawal period ends; you get a deposit receipt.
rules.quote: L’acquéreur a droit à se rétracter du contrat de réservation, dans un délai n’excédant pas un (1) mois à compter de la date de conclusion du contrat de réservation. Le vendeur doit, en cas de rétractation de l’acquéreur du contrat de réservation, lui restituer le montant total avancé dans un délai n’excédant pas sept (7) jours à compter de la date de l’exercice de ce droit. [...] La validité du contrat de réservation est fixée à un délai n’excédant pas six (6) mois non renouvelables et qui conduit obligatoirement soit à la conclusion du contrat préliminaire de vente, soit à la rétractation du contrat de réservation et la restitution des montants avancés. Le vendeur dépose, dans un compte bancaire spécial et en son nom, les montants versés par les acquéreurs lors de la conclusion des contrats de réservation et dans les limites prévues par l’article 618-6 ci-dessous. Les montants déposés ne sont susceptibles ni d’en disposer ni d’en saisir, et ce, jusqu’à l’expiration du délai du droit de rétractation relatif à chaque contrat. En contrepartie, l’acquéreur reçoit un récépissé de dépôt.
rules.translation: The buyer has the right to withdraw from the reservation contract within a period not exceeding one (1) month from the date the reservation contract was concluded. If the buyer withdraws from the reservation contract, the seller must return the full amount advanced within a period not exceeding seven (7) days from the date this right is exercised. [...] A reservation contract is valid for a period not exceeding six (6) months, not renewable, which must lead either to the conclusion of the preliminary sale contract or to withdrawal from the reservation contract and the return of the amounts advanced. The seller deposits, in a special bank account in its name, the amounts paid by buyers when reservation contracts are concluded, within the limits set by article 618-6 below. The amounts deposited can be neither used nor seized until the withdrawal period for each contract has expired. In return, the buyer receives a deposit receipt.

rules.title: The law caps each payment stage: 5% at reservation, 5% at the preliminary contract, 10% at start of works, 60% in three build stages, 20% at the keys
rules.plain: You pay at most a part of the total price as the works progress: 5% at the reservation contract, 5% at the preliminary contract (or 10% if there was no reservation), 10% when works start, 60% in three stages (foundations up to ground floor, structural works of the whole building, finishing and the occupancy permit or certificate of conformity) and the last 20% at the final sale contract and handover of the keys.
rules.quote: L’acquéreur est tenu de payer au maximum une partie du prix global au fur et à mesure de l’avancement des travaux selon les phases suivantes : -5% à la conclusion du contrat de réservation ; -5% à la conclusion du contrat préliminaire ou 10% en cas de non existence du contrat de réservation ; -10% au lancement des travaux ; -60% divisé en trois phases à payer, selon l’accord des parties, à l’achèvement des travaux de réalisation de chaque phase ; -phase des travaux relatifs aux fondations de la construction au niveau du rez-de-chaussée ; -phase des travaux des gros œuvres de l’ensemble de l’immeuble ; -phase des travaux de finition et l’obtention du permis d’habiter ou du certificat de conformité. -20% à la conclusion du contrat de vente définitif et la remise des clés.
rules.translation: The buyer is required to pay at most a part of the total price as the works progress, in the following stages: 5% when the reservation contract is concluded; 5% when the preliminary contract is concluded, or 10% if there is no reservation contract; 10% when the works start; 60% split into three stages, payable as agreed by the parties on completion of the works of each stage: the foundation works up to ground-floor level; the structural works of the whole building; the finishing works and the obtaining of the occupancy permit or the certificate of conformity; 20% when the final sale contract is concluded and the keys are handed over.

rules.title: No contract before the building permit, and any payment before a signed contract is void
rules.plain: A preliminary sale contract for an off-plan building can only be signed after the building permit has been issued. Any payment of any kind made before the preliminary sale contract, or before the reservation contract if one is used, is null and void. Do not pay anything before a written contract.
rules.quote: Le contrat préliminaire de vente de l’immeuble en l’état futur d’achèvement ne peut être conclu qu’après l’obtention du permis de construire. [...] Est considéré comme nul et non avenu, tout paiement de quelque nature que ce soit, avant la signature du contrant préliminaire de vente ou du contrat de réservation en cas de recours à ce dernier.
rules.translation: The preliminary contract for the sale of a building in the future state of completion may only be concluded after the building permit has been obtained. [...] Any payment of any kind made before the signature of the preliminary sale contract, or of the reservation contract where one is used, is considered null and void.

rules.title: After the preliminary contract, the seller must give you a completion guarantee or a refund guarantee
rules.plain: Once the preliminary sale contract is signed, the seller must set up in your favour either a guarantee that the works will be completed or a guarantee that the instalments you paid will be refunded if the contract is not performed. The professional who drew up the contract may release instalments deposited with them to the seller only after the seller has obtained a guarantee covering all the instalments you paid.
rules.quote: Le vendeur doit, après la signature du contrat préliminaire de vente, constituer au profit de l’acquéreur soit une garantie d’achévement des travaux soit une garantie de remboursement des échéances payées en cas de non-exécution du contrat. [...] La partie qui a dressé le contrat ne peut débloquer les échéances qui sont déposées auprès d’elle au profit du vendeur qu’après l’obtention de ce dernier d’une garantie couvrant toutes les échéances payées par l’acquéreur.
rules.translation: After the preliminary sale contract is signed, the seller must set up in favour of the buyer either a guarantee of completion of the works or a guarantee of refund of the instalments paid if the contract is not performed. [...] The party who drew up the contract may release to the seller the instalments deposited with it only after the seller has obtained a guarantee covering all the instalments paid by the buyer.

rules.title: In Panama, a promise to sell a new home must state the delivery date, and if it is missed you can cancel and get all your money back
rules.plain: The promise of sale of a new home must state a fixed or determinable delivery date. If the seller misses it for a reason it says is not its fault, it must put the reasons in writing. If the delivery date is missed, you may end the contract and get back everything you paid, with no penalty of any kind.
rules.quote: En los contratos de promesa de compraventa de construcciones nuevas debe constar la fecha cierta o determinable de entrega. En caso de incumplimiento por causa no imputable al proveedor, deberán dejarse por escrito las causas por las cuales no se hizo la entrega del inmueble en el plazo establecido. En caso de incumplimiento del plazo de entrega, el consumidor tendrá la opción de dar por terminado el contrato, con la correspondiente devolución total de las sumas abonadas y sin ningún tipo de penalización.
rules.translation: Promise-of-sale contracts for new buildings must state the fixed or determinable delivery date. In case of non-performance for a cause not attributable to the supplier, the causes for which the property was not delivered within the set period must be put in writing. In case of failure to meet the delivery date, the consumer will have the option to terminate the contract, with the corresponding full refund of the sums paid and without any kind of penalty.

rules.title: The developer's advertising is part of your contract, and the building warranty must be in writing
rules.plain: The seller of a new home must set out the terms and conditions of the building warranty clearly and in writing, with each type of cover detailed. Its advertising forms part of the sale contract: flyers, brochures, books or any other material it hands out bind the seller, and you can demand what they promise. Keep copies of every brochure.
rules.quote: El proveedor de construcciones residenciales nuevas deberá establecer, de manera clara y por escrito, los términos y las condiciones de la garantía de la obra. En caso de que existan diferentes coberturas en la garantía, estas deberán estar debidamente detalladas. La publicidad de las construcciones residenciales nuevas formará parte integral del contrato de compraventa suscrito entre el proveedor y el consumidor. Los anuncios que se publiciten en volantes, panfletos, libros o por cualquier otro medio que el proveedor distribuya son vinculantes para este y exigibles por el consumidor.
rules.translation: The supplier of new residential buildings must set out, clearly and in writing, the terms and conditions of the building warranty. Where the warranty has different types of cover, they must be properly detailed. The advertising of new residential buildings will form an integral part of the sale contract signed between the supplier and the consumer. Advertisements published in flyers, pamphlets, books or by any other means the supplier distributes are binding on it and enforceable by the consumer.

rules.title: The contract must state the total price and when it can change, and you can ask for a lower price if the home differs from the contract
rules.plain: The contract must state the total amount you will pay and the cases in which the price may be adjusted. If building material costs rise, the consumer protection authority sets how such adjustments are checked. If the finished home's features or specifications differ substantially from those in the contract, you may demand a proportional price reduction.
rules.quote: Los contratos deberán expresar el total de las sumas a pagar, así como los casos en que se podrán adoptar ajustes en el precio. En caso de aumento de los costos de materiales de construcción, la Autoridad establecerá los parámetros y los procedimientos técnicos para verificar dichos ajustes. El consumidor podrá exigir rebajas proporcionales en el precio de las construcciones nuevas, cuando sus condiciones o especificaciones finales hayan variado sustancialmente de las establecidas previamente en el contrato.
rules.translation: Contracts must state the total of the sums to be paid, and the cases in which price adjustments may be made. If the costs of building materials rise, the Authority will set the parameters and technical procedures for checking such adjustments. The consumer may demand proportional reductions in the price of new buildings when their final conditions or specifications have varied substantially from those previously set in the contract.

rules.title: In Argentina, insurance against the failure of an off-plan sale is now optional, so ask the developer for it
rules.plain: Contracts for units sold before the building is set up under horizontal property (off-plan) fall under the Code's pre-horizontal-property chapter. Since Decree 1017/2024, the owner of the land may, but no longer must, take out insurance in your favour against the risk that the operation fails. Ask whether such a policy exists and get a copy before you pay.
rules.quote: Los contratos sobre unidades funcionales celebrados antes de la constitución de la propiedad horizontal están incluidos en las disposiciones de este Capítulo. [...] Al celebrar contratos sobre unidades construidas o proyectadas bajo el régimen de propiedad horizontal, el titular del dominio del inmueble podrá constituir un seguro a favor del adquirente, para el riesgo del fracaso de la operación de acuerdo a lo convenido por las partes.
rules.translation: Contracts on functional units concluded before the horizontal property is set up are covered by the provisions of this Chapter. [...] When concluding contracts on units built or planned under the horizontal property regime, the owner of the property may take out insurance in favour of the buyer, for the risk of failure of the operation as agreed by the parties.

rules.title: A buyer who has paid at least 25% under a dated sale agreement ranks ahead of later creditors' attachments
rules.plain: Your right as a good-faith buyer under a sale agreement (boleto) has priority over third parties who later attach the property if: you contracted with the registered owner (or can trace an unbroken chain back to them), you paid at least 25% of the price before the attachment, the agreement has a certain date, and the purchase has enough publicity, either by registration or by possession. Get the boleto dated (for example, certified) and registered or take possession.
rules.quote: El derecho del comprador de buena fe tiene prioridad sobre el de terceros que hayan trabado cautelares sobre el inmueble vendido si: a) el comprador contrató con el titular registral, o puede subrogarse en la posición jurídica de quien lo hizo mediante un perfecto eslabonamiento con los adquirentes sucesivos; b) el comprador pagó como mínimo el veinticinco por ciento del precio con anterioridad a la traba de la cautelar; c) el boleto tiene fecha cierta; d) la adquisición tiene publicidad suficiente, sea registral, sea posesoria.
rules.translation: The right of the good-faith buyer has priority over that of third parties who have placed attachments on the property sold if: a) the buyer contracted with the registered owner, or can take over the legal position of whoever did so through a perfect chain of successive buyers; b) the buyer paid at least twenty-five per cent of the price before the attachment was placed; c) the sale agreement has a certain date; d) the purchase has sufficient publicity, whether by registration or by possession.

rules.title: If the seller goes bankrupt, a dated sale agreement with at least 25% paid still binds the estate, and the judge orders the deed
rules.plain: Dated sale agreements in favour of good-faith buyers bind the seller's insolvency or bankruptcy estate if at least 25% of the price has been paid. The judge must order the title deed to be granted, and you may pay the rest on the agreed schedule; if you still owe instalments, a first-ranking mortgage on the property secures the balance.
rules.quote: Los boletos de compraventa de inmuebles de fecha cierta otorgados a favor de adquirentes de buena fe son oponibles al concurso o quiebra del vendedor si se hubiera abonado como mínimo el veinticinco por ciento del precio. El juez debe disponer que se otorgue la respectiva escritura pública. El comprador puede cumplir sus obligaciones en el plazo convenido. En caso de que la prestación a cargo del comprador sea a plazo, debe constituirse hipoteca en primer grado sobre el bien, en garantía del saldo de precio.
rules.translation: Property sale agreements with a certain date granted in favour of good-faith buyers are enforceable against the seller's insolvency proceedings or bankruptcy if at least twenty-five per cent of the price has been paid. The judge must order the corresponding public deed to be granted. The buyer may perform its obligations within the agreed period. Where the buyer's payment is in instalments, a first-ranking mortgage must be created on the property to secure the balance of the price.
